description:
Configure the Jitsi Meet server to enforce a 'quiet start' policy. You must modify the web configuration file (`config.js`) so that all users join meetings with their Audio and Video muted by default. 

1. Locate and edit `/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/config.js`.
2. Set `startWithAudioMuted` and `startWithVideoMuted` to `true`.
3. Reload Firefox and join a new meeting room named 'QuietMeeting' to verify the policy works (you should start muted).
